sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is an open-weight multimodal model built for real-world coding, agent workflows, and long-context reasoning. It combines a causal language model with a vision encoder, supports text, image, and video inputs, and is optimized for frameworks such as Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, and KTransformers.
